title: Sacred Grove Ritual Simulation
description: The user orchestrates an ancient ritual in a sacred grove where a humanoid figure (RiggedFigure) performs ceremonial movements around the Nemetona shrine. The user controls wind intensity, time of day, ritual dance speed, offering placement, fire intensity, and camera orbit to achieve a harmonious energy balance displayed via a real-time HUD.
prompt: Create a single HTML file using Three.js r170 (importmap with es-module-shims) implementing a Sacred Grove Ritual Simulation. Load both GLB assets: place nemetona.glb at the world origin as a central shrine, and place RiggedFigure.glb 3 units away facing the shrine. Set up a PerspectiveCamera at position (0, 4, 10) looking at the origin. Add ambient light (intensity 0.3), a warm DirectionalLight simulating sunlight, and a PointLight near the shrine simulating fire glow. Create a ground plane with green-brown MeshStandardMaterial. Add OrbitControls constrained to polar angle 10-80 degrees. Implement these 8 interaction steps with validation: (1) A 'Time of Day' slider (0-24 hours) that adjusts DirectionalLight color/intensity and sky background color gradient, validated to numeric range. (2) A 'Wind Intensity' slider (0-100) that applies sinusoidal oscillation to any mesh children of nemetona, validated 0-100. (3) A 'Ritual Speed' slider (0.1-3.0) controlling the RiggedFigure's circular orbit speed around the shrine using AnimationMixer timeScale if animations exist, otherwise rotating its position around Y-axis, validated to float range. (4) A 'Fire Intensity' slider (1-10) controlling the PointLight intensity and color temperature near the shrine, validated integer range. (5) A button 'Place Offering' that spawns a small golden sphere (max 5) at a random position between the figure and shrine, each click validated against the 5-offering cap. (6) A 'Shrine Glow' slider (0-1) adding emissive intensity to nemetona's materials, validated to float range. (7) A 'Begin Ceremony' toggle button that simultaneously activates figure orbiting, pulsing shrine glow, and flickering fire light in a coordinated animation loop, only enabled when at least 2 offerings are placed. (8) A 'Harmony Score' HUD element (top-right, styled div) that computes a 0-100 score based on weighted combination of all parameters and displays it updating each frame. Use requestAnimationFrame loop. All sliders in a left-side panel with labels and current values. Ensure all parameter changes reflect immediately in the 3D scene.
